title: The Yuba County Five Disappearance
hook: Five men vanished from a library, never fully explained?
headline: Missing men, desert cabin mystery

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On February 24, 1978, five men were reported missing after attending a basketball game at California State University, Chico.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: They were later found in a remote area of Plumas National Forest; the vehicle was a 1969 Mercury Montego, not a Volkswagen Beetle.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The bodies were discovered in June 1978; none were found alive.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Autopsies showed deaths from starvation and hypothermia; no dehydration weeks later.

end.line: What could have caused their tragic disappearance?

description: Explore the baffling 1978 disappearance of five disabled men in Yuba County.

facts.claim: Five men left the Yuba City library on February 24, 1978.
Their Volkswagen Beetle was found near a remote cabin in the Sierra foothills.
The men were discovered on March 12, 1978, with some still alive.
Autopsies indicated one died of exposure, others of dehydration.
They were missing for approximately 27 days.
